KXATPGWINNER.note: No markets listed and no rules sampled. Title 'ATP Game Winner' is a single-game winner (hold/break process), which game_winner_inplay generates; match_winner would misstate the mechanism. NO_LISTING/low is honest.

KXATPMEN.note: No markets listed, no rules. 'Mens ATP Tournament Winner' duplicates the KXATP outright family (rules-verified sibling); tournament_winner_futures is the generating mechanism. NO_LISTING/low correct.

KXATPS1GWINNER.note: No markets listed, no rules. 'Set 1 game winner' is a game inside set 1, not the set winner; game_winner_inplay (serve hold/break given live score) is the right existing mechanism. Not a catch-all, so no new archetype needed.

KXATPS3GWINNER.note: No markets listed, no rules. Same family as S1/S4/S5 game-winner series; game-within-set winner is generated by the in-play game archetype's serve/return process. Agree, low confidence.

KXATPS4GWINNER.note: No markets listed, no rules. Set-4 game winner implies best-of-five (Slam) context but the mechanism is still a single game's hold/break; game_winner_inplay fits. Agree.

KXATPS5GWINNER.note: No markets listed, no rules. Set-5 game winner (deciding set, possible super-tiebreak treatment unverified) is still a game-level outcome under game_winner_inplay. Agree, low confidence.

KXATPSETSWEEP.note: No markets listed, no rules. Scope ambiguous: match-level straight-sets win (set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events) vs tournament winner who never drops a set (closer to tournament futures). Sweep archetype is the best title-only fit; low confidence preserves that uncertainty.

KXATPTIEBREAK.note: No markets listed, no rules. 'Tiebreak to occur in Match' is an occurrence event (any set reaching 6-6), generated by hold-rate parity, exactly the set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events target; not a winner market. Agree.

KXWTABLETENNISMATCH.note: No markets listed, no rules. Title names table tennis, a different sport (games to 11, rally scoring) unaffected by tennis performance; OUT_OF_SCOPE:other_sport_table_tennis with medium (max allowed without rules) is correct.
